name: Iceland — Golden Circle, South Coast & Snæfellsnes

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Land 6:05 AM after the overnight flight from Boston; pick up the rental car.

stops.name: Hallgrímskirkja
stops.notes: Tower elevator for the view over the city.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Staying with a friend. Walking loop: Skólavörðustígur (Rainbow Street) to Laugavegur, old harbor, Sun Voyager sculpture. No driving pressure today.

extras.name: Skólavörðustígur (Rainbow Street)
extras.notes: Walking loop: down Rainbow Street to Laugavegur.

extras.name: Laugavegur
extras.notes: Coffee and browsing.

extras.name: Sun Voyager (Sólfar)
extras.photo: 1990 zum 200-jährigen Jubiläum von Reykjavik wurde die Skulptur Solfar (Sonnenfahrt) enthüllt. 01.jpg

extras.name: Harpa Concert Hall
extras.notes: If energy allows.

extras.name: Tjörnin
extras.notes: City pond, if energy allows.

extras.name: Perlan Museum & Öskjuhlíð forest
extras.notes: Museum + forest walk. Perlan's exhibits are also a good indoor fallback if it's rough out.

extras.name: Grandi harbour district & Saga Museum
extras.notes: Saga Museum, breweries.

stops.name: Þingvellir
stops.notes: Rift valley, tectonic plates.

stops.name: Geysir
stops.notes: Geothermal area; Strokkur erupts every few minutes.

stops.name: Gullfoss
stops.notes: Waterfall.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Back by mid-to-late afternoon or early evening — room for Laugardalur pool or dinner.

extras.name: Brúarfoss
extras.notes: Optional detour: smaller, bluer waterfall.

extras.name: Þjóðveldisbærinn
extras.notes: Reconstructed Commonwealth-era farm. Hours unverified — may be closed for the season.

extras.name: Laugardalslaug
extras.notes: Evening pool soak in Laugardalur.

stops.name: Seljalandsfoss
stops.notes: Waterfall you can walk behind.

stops.name: Dyrhólaey
stops.notes: Coastal promontory, arch rock.

stops.name: Reynisfjara
stops.notes: Black sand beach, basalt columns; Víkurkirkja nearby.

stops.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
stops.notes: Canyon.

stops.name: Skyrhúsið Guesthouse, Hali
stops.notes: Heaviest driving day of the trip — arriving late evening is fine. Night 1 away from Reykjavik.

extras.name: Gljúfrabúi
extras.notes: Hidden waterfall, a short walk from Seljalandsfoss.

extras.name: Sólheimajökull
extras.notes: Glacier viewpoint, if time allows (otherwise Day 5).

extras.name: Víkurkirkja
extras.notes: Church above Vík.

extras.name: Kirkjugólf
extras.notes: Basalt 'church floor', on the way past Kirkjubæjarklaustur.

extras.name: Systrafoss
extras.notes: If Reynisfjara is closed for high waves: sub in Kirkjugólf + Systrafoss.

stops.name: Jökulsárlón
stops.notes: Glacier lagoon + Diamond Beach.

stops.name: Skaftafell
stops.notes: Glacier hike + Katla ice cave tour, 9:45 AM (booked).

stops.name: Fox Hostel, Hrífunes
stops.notes: Night 2 away.

extras.name: Diamond Beach
extras.notes: Ice chunks on black sand, across the road from Jökulsárlón.

extras.name: Fjallsárlón
extras.notes: Quieter glacier lagoon, if time/energy allow.

extras.name: Svartifoss
extras.notes: Basalt-column waterfall, hike up from Skaftafell.

extras.name: Vatnajökull visitor centre (Skaftafellsstofa)
extras.notes: If the glacier/ice cave tour is weathered out (operators rebook or refund); also the Jökulsárlón boat tour or extra time at Diamond Beach.

extras.name: Eldhraun lava field
extras.notes: Quick stop at the moss-covered lava field.

stops.name: Skógafoss
stops.notes: Waterfall.

stops.name: Vík Hostel
stops.notes: Night 3 away.

extras.name: Sólheimajökull
extras.notes: If not done on Day 3. Short walk from the parking lot, fine in bad weather.

extras.name: Múlagljúfur
extras.notes: Canyon near Kvísker.

extras.name: Kötlusetur (Katla Geopark centre) & Skaftfellingur museum
extras.notes: Indoor options in Vík if it's a washout.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Short drive back (~2.5–3 hrs) — the slack day. Room to catch up on anything skipped earlier in the week.

extras.name: Reykjadalur hot river
extras.notes: Hot river valley hike, en route.

extras.name: Skógar Museum
extras.notes: Bad weather day: indoor turf houses + folk history.

stops.name: Arnarstapi
stops.notes: Coastal walking path to Hellnar; Gatklettur rock arch.

stops.name: Djúpalónssandur
stops.notes: Black pebble beach, shipwreck remains.

stops.name: Kirkjufell
stops.notes: Headline stop of the day, saved for last; Kirkjufellsfoss alongside it.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Long day, 10–12 hrs round trip, depart by 7–8 AM. Evening: dinner and a short wind-down — optional Sky Lagoon or Laugardalur pool.

extras.name: Gatklettur

extras.name: Snæfellsjökull National Park visitor centre (Malarrif)
extras.notes: Indoor fallback, along with Arnarstapi's cafes.

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Drop off rental car 2:00 PM. Depart 5:10 PM, arrive Boston 6:50 PM.

extras.name: Blue Lagoon
extras.notes: On the way to the airport. Sells out in advance — not yet booked.

extras.name: Viðey Island
extras.notes: Short ferry from the old harbor: trails, birdlife, Imagine Peace Tower. Half-day trip.

extras.name: Nauthólsvík Geothermal Beach
extras.notes: Man-made geothermal beach near Öskjuhlíð/Perlan; small fee for a hot pot soak.

extras.notes: Historic buildings and old Reykjavik houses.

extras.name: Esja
extras.notes: Half-day hike ~10 km north of the city.
